claims.summary: Likely Snag: first_word_after (L89) split_whitespace+trim_matches might fail to identify 'as' when a marker is followed by a parenthetical e.g. '[MARKER] (as a test)'.

Per source L89-96, trim_matches(|c| !alnum && c!='_') strips the leading '(' fused inside the chunk '(as', yielding 'as'; distinct from the existing '--'/':' regressions where punctuation is a SEPARATE chunk skipped by find(!empty). Added regression control_marker_cleanup_first_word_after_trims_fused_leading_parenthesis pinning it (listed 'as' preserved; unlisted 'acts' removed). Test passes.
